title: DuckOgloszenia
body:
# DuckOgloszenia – Simple & Elegant Server Announcements
duckOgloszenia is a lightweight, high-performance, and easy-to-use announcement plugin designed for Minecraft 1.21+ servers. Developed in Java 21, it provides server administrators with a powerful tool to capture players' attention instantly using the Title system.

 Instead of important messages getting lost in the fast-moving chat, duckOgloszenia displays your announcements directly in the center of every player's screen. Whether you are announcing a server restart, a spontaneous event, or a crucial rule update, this plugin ensures that nobody misses the word.
